The feedback system includes: rating submission (1-6 scale), duplicate device prevention, max limit enforcement, batch fetch, global stats, training profile, and settings management.

critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering correctly implemented - static routes (/feedback/stats, /feedback/training-profile, /feedback/batch) come before dynamic route /feedback/{intelligence_id}
Device fingerprint stored in localStorage with key 'rhino_drishti_device_id' for duplicate prevention
Batch endpoint efficiently fetches feedback for multiple items in single request
Aggregation properly updates intelligence items with feedback_avg_rating, feedback_total_ratings, feedback_derived_relevance
Training profile correctly calculates positive/negative weights based on high-rated (>=4.0) and low-rated (<3.0) items
Confidence level properly calculated: HIGH (>=100), MODERATE (>=30), LOW (>=10), INSUFFICIENT_DATA (<10)
